import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths as given
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_8.csv"
]

# Target schema columns and their types (for reference)
target_columns = [
    'average_salary',  # string
    'city_state',      # string
    'company_id',      # integer
    'company_info',    # string
    'company_name',    # string
    'company_rating',  # float
    'country_name',    # string
    'job_desc',        # string
    'job_title',       # string
    'post_date'        # string
]

# Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema (all sources have same schema)
    # Convert company_id to integer (some sources might have it as float)
    if df['company_id'].dtype != 'int64' and df['company_id'].dtype != 'int32':
        # Some company_id might be float, convert safely to int
        df['company_id'] = df['company_id'].astype(int)
    # Convert company_rating to float (some might be object if NaNs or strings)
    df['company_rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['company_rating'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert average_salary to string (some have NaN or numeric)
    df['average_salary'] = df['average_salary'].astype(str).replace('nan', pd.NA)
    # Convert all other columns to string to match target schema types where applicable
    df['city_state'] = df['city_state'].astype(str)
    df['company_info'] = df['company_info'].astype(str)
    df['company_name'] = df['company_name'].astype(str)
    df['country_name'] = df['country_name'].astype(str)
    df['job_desc'] = df['job_desc'].astype(str)
    df['job_title'] = df['job_title'].astype(str)
    df['post_date'] = df['post_date'].astype(str)
    dfs.append(df[target_columns])

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# After union, ensure data types are consistent with target schema
# average_salary: string (already string with pd.NA for missing)
target_df['average_salary'] = target_df['average_salary'].astype('string')

# city_state: string
target_df['city_state'] = target_df['city_state'].astype('string')

# company_id: integer
target_df['company_id'] = target_df['company_id'].astype('int64')

# company_info: string
target_df['company_info'] = target_df['company_info'].astype('string')

# company_name: string
target_df['company_name'] = target_df['company_name'].astype('string')

# company_rating: float
target_df['company_rating'] = pd.to_numeric(target_df['company_rating'], errors='coerce')

# country_name: string
target_df['country_name'] = target_df['country_name'].astype('string')

# job_desc: string
target_df['job_desc'] = target_df['job_desc'].astype('string')

# job_title: string
target_df['job_title'] = target_df['job_title'].astype('string')

# post_date: string
target_df['post_date'] = target_df['post_date'].astype('string')

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/training_8.csv"
]

dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY all non-float columns that serve as keys/identifiers
# Target schema:
# ['average_salary': string, 'city_state': string, 'company_id': integer, 'company_info': string,
#  'company_name': string, 'company_rating': float, 'country_name': string, 'job_desc': string,
#  'job_title': string, 'post_date': string]

# Group by all columns except company_rating (float)
group_by_cols = [
    'country_name', 'city_state', 'average_salary', 'company_id',
    'company_name', 'company_info', 'job_desc', 'job_title', 'post_date'
]

# Aggregate company_rating by max to keep highest rating per group
df_final = df.groupby(group_by_cols, dropna=False, as_index=False).agg({'company_rating': 'max'})

# Ensure column order matches target schema exactly
df_final = df_final[
    ['average_salary', 'city_state', 'company_id', 'company_info', 'company_name',
     'company_rating', 'country_name', 'job_desc', 'job_title', 'post_date']
]

# Write output CSV without index
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_6/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
